messages.content: What's the lowest score in the Flappy Bird game?

function.name: game_tracker_high_score
function.description: Retrieves the highest score recorded in the specified game. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

game_name.description: The name of the game to get the high score for.

username.description: The username of the player. (optional) Default: 'john'

platform.description: The platform where the game was played, i.e PC, Xbox, Playstation, Mobile.

message.content: I’m sorry, but I don’t have a way to look up the lowest score for Flappy Bird. The function I have access to only retrieves high scores. If you’d like to know the highest score instead—or if there’s another way I can help—just let me know!

The function signature: game_tracker_high_score expects game_name, optional username default 'john', platform. But it's for high score. There's no function for low score. The user wants lowest score. We don't have a function for that. We can respond that we cannot retrieve lowest score because function only provides high score. We can ask clarifying question or explain limitation. According to policy, we should not fabricate data. So we should say we can't retrieve lowest score. Maybe ask if they want high score instead.
